research_gaps: Falmouth chamber guidebook listing (Celebrations of Cape Cod, Masterson Made) and the Mashpee chamber listing (FabVilla): unverifiable at the 2026-11-15 re-check, so no chamber listing is cited for these three shops.
Provincetown Fudge Factory: the post's hours text is on a graphic; the quote is the text the fact-checker recorded from the Nov 1 post.
Cabot's Candy Factory and Chatham Candy Manor: no hours found on the pages read.
Cape Cod Museum of Natural History: the shop's own hours and description were not found; the hours given are the museum's.
DRIFT Wellfleet: driftwellfleet.com did not load for the fact-checker; the address and hours are from its Instagram profile and the chamber phone number is not published here.
Snow's Home & Garden: snowscapecod.com did not load for the fact-checker; the address and description are from its Instagram profile and the site banner is not used.
Chatham Kids: the parent site chathamclothingbar.com shows no address or phone; the address is from the Instagram profile.
Atlantic Spice Company, Nauset Lantern Shop, Bass River Mercantile: undated website text only; no social proof found.

Several 'site description says' quotes (Candy Manor, Yankee Ingenuity, Nut House, Stage Stop, Ross Coppelman, Brewster Store, Masterson Made, Cabot's, Kandy Korner, Nauset) were found in the page meta description, not visible text.
By-the-Bay Designs, Wellfleet Marine Retail Store, Celebrations of Cape Cod: Facebook post ages are relative ('3 hours', 'Yesterday') as shown on the check day, not stored timestamps.
Ross Coppelman: hours still labelled Spring Hours on its site; not repeated.
Truro Vineyards: no on-site gift shop described on the pages read.
